name: Santa Monica Paradise
source:
After finishing a painful divorce, renowned New York chef Peter Kellerman accepts an invitation from his multi-millionaire brother to spend a weekend at his villa in Santa Monica. To his surprise, he finds his brother away on a business meeting and a mysterious woman living in his house…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1322260/Santa_Monica_Paradise/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
结束痛苦的离婚后，纽约著名厨师彼得·凯勒曼接受百万富翁兄弟的邀请，前往他位于圣莫尼卡的别墅度周末。令他惊讶的是，他发现哥哥外出参加商务会议，而他的家里却住着一个神秘的女人……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1322260/Santa_Monica_Paradise/]Steam[/url]]
